2-4 项；填了就不能带媒体: 2-4 items; cannot be combined with media
id 或嘟文链接都行: Either the ID or the post link works
上限由实例决定（多数 500，不少中文实例 5000+）。链接、#话题、@某人: The limit is decided by the instance (most are 500; many Chinese instances are 5000+). Links, #hashtags and @mentions are recognized automatically by the instance, no processing needed from the plugin
不列出（可见但不进公共时间线）: Unlisted (visible but not in public timelines)
你的账号所在实例，如 https://mastodon.social 或 htt: The instance your account is on, e.g. https://mastodon.social or https://m.cmx.im
发一条 Mastodon 嘟文，可带图、内容警告、可见性与投票: Publishes a Mastodon post, optionally with images, a content warning, visibility and a poll
发嘟文、发嘟文串、删嘟文。免费、无审批、无按次计费，且因为是联邦网络，: Post, post threads, and delete posts. Free, no approval needed, no per-call charge, and because it is a federated network,
只能删授权账号自己发的: Can only delete posts made by the authorized account itself
可直接点开或发进通知: Can be opened directly or sent in a notification
图片会先打码，点了才看: Images are blurred by default and only shown when clicked
填了则正文折叠，先显示这行提示。联邦圈的惯例：敏感/长内容都该折起来: When set, the body is collapsed behind this hint. A fediverse convention: sensitive or long content should be collapsed
填了就是回复: Set this to make it a reply
如 http://127.0.0.1:7897；部署环境直连不了该实例时必填: E.g. http://127.0.0.1:7897; required if the deployment environment cannot reach this instance directly
实例里「偏好设置 → 开发 → 新建应用」，作用域勾 write:statuse: In the instance, go to Preferences → Development → New application, check the scopes write:statuses, write:media and read:accounts, then copy "Your access token" from the application detail page
把多段文本发成一串首尾相连的嘟文；后续条目默认继承首条的可见性与 CW: Publishes several pieces of text as a chain of posts, each replying to the previous one; later posts inherit the first post's visibility and CW by default
按发出顺序；中途失败时是**已经发出去的那几条**: In the order posted; if it fails partway through, these are **the posts that were already sent**
按顺序逐条发出，后一条自动回复前一条。本操作不替你断句: Sent one by one in order, each automatically replying to the previous one. This operation does not split your text into sentences for you
最多 4 个（投票时不能带）: Up to 4 (cannot be combined with a poll)
私信（只有被 @ 的人可见）: Direct message (visible only to mentioned accounts)
验一次访问令牌。ok=false 表示令牌被撤销或作用域不够: Verifies the access token once. ok=false means the token was revoked or lacks sufficient scope
